SHA-256 fallback from @noble/hashes **2.4.0**, distributed under MIT.

Upstream: https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-hashes

Files copied unchanged from the npm release tarball: sha2.js, _md.js, _u64.js, utils.js. See LICENSE for the complete notice. No runtime network request or npm install is needed by the website. HTTPS uses the browser's Web Crypto implementation; HTTP development previews use this fallback.
